$comment: Label-on-fill contrast matrix (#3896): every filled CMP-001 Button role, the label token it binds, and the fill token of each interaction state that exists as a token.

Checked in every theme by packages/ui/test/contrast/label-on-fill.test.ts (the CI gate, unit-frontend; labels also in every chart colour mode) and by packages/ui/tokens/tests/verify_tokens.py (the token proof).

A label clears `label` (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3) on every state fill. A role's states are pairwise at least `stateLightness` apart in CIE L*, and where `hue` is set each state is within `stateHue` degrees of LCh hue of the rest fill.

Where `boundary` is set, the rest fill clears `boundary` (SC 1.4.11) against every surface in `surfaces`. Hover and pressed fills are not held to it: SC 1.4.11 does not require a hover or pressed indicator to contrast with the rest state, and under a white label no three dark primary states 5 L* apart fit the band that clears both 4.5:1 and 3:1.

Disabled with reason: the reason tooltip text clears `label` on its surface, and the locked glyph (the label colour) clears `glyph` on the rest fill or, for ghost, on the surface. The dimmed label of an inactive control (`opacity.disabled`) is exempt under SC 1.4.3 and is not checked.

A state with no token (danger hover and active, buy and sell active, secondary active) is owner decision A2 of the E05-D02 component spec (#161, PR #3914); once its token lands it must be added here, and the gate fails on any `<role>.<stateSuffix>` token missing from this list.
